title: Behavior Guard — agent verdict input
description: Written by the existing-app test agent to .github/.pipeline-context/verify/<id>.behavior.verdict.json after reading <id>.behavior.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-behavior.js. Answers: did real behavior change beyond what the plan intended?

verdict.description: BEHAVIOR_PRESERVED: every change is explained by the plan's stated scope. BEHAVIOR_CHANGED: something changed that the plan does not account for. INCONCLUSIVE: the worktree/materialization failed or the diff can't be fully assessed.

in_scope_changes.description: Changes that are the intended implementation, each traced to the plan's acceptanceCriteriaPlan.

out_of_scope_changes.description: Required non-empty when verdict is BEHAVIOR_CHANGED. Anything the diff does that the plan doesn't explain.
